output_list.criticism: The function EAI_TokenERC20 has an integer overflow vulnerability. The variable totalSupply is initialized to 10 ** uint256(decimals) * initialSupply, which can cause an overflow if the value of decimals is large enough. This can lead to a successful exploit.
The function _transfer has wrong logic. The function does not check if the value of balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than or equal to balanceOf[_to]. This can lead to a successful exploit.
The function transfer has bad randomness. The function does not check if the value of balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than or equal to balanceOf[_to]. This can lead to a successful exploit.
The function transferFrom has bad randomness. The function does not check if the value of balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than or equal to balanceOf[_to]. This can lead to a successful exploit.
The function burn has bad randomness. The function does not check if the value of balanceOf[msg.sender] >= _value. This can lead to a successful exploit.
The function burnFrom has bad randomness. The function does not check if the value of balanceOf[_from] >= _value. This can lead to a successful exploit.
